executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under heavy pressure. Server DRAM, HBM, DRAM are currently among the most strained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-16 reviewed eight relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material directional change. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
